attribution: Place names, coordinates and populations from GeoNames, CC BY 4.0
method: Populated places below city level from the GeoNames entity store, linked to the nearest city in the same country within 25 km. The parent city must have at least 250,000 inhabitants and at least 8 districts, and a place the city store already carries is excluded so that a district cannot become a hub over its neighbours.
derivation: Parent city assigned by nearest centre within 25 km. GeoNames records no parent city for these places.
caution: A district list is not an administrative boundary list. GeoNames coverage below city level is uneven between countries, so a city with eight districts here may have thirty in reality, and the page says how many it is naming rather than claiming to name them all.
